• Prepare, file, and monitor trademark, copyright, patent, and industrial design applications with DJKI, and support international filings (Madrid Protocol, PCT) with foreign counsel and consultants
• Conduct trademark clearance and prior-art searches, summarize risks, and respond to office actions and oppositions within statutory deadlines
• Review IP-related agreements (NDAs, license, development, distribution, collaboration, consultancy, employment), identify IP risks, and propose revisions
• Maintain the IP register, powers of attorney, and files, and track renewals, annuities, and recordals
• Monitor marketplaces, social media, and domain names for infringement, and assist with cease-and-desist letters, takedowns, and enforcement matters with external counsel
• Support IP due diligence and third-party infringement risk checks for partnerships and new products
• Serve as the IP point of contact for internal teams, guide proper use of company brands and third-party content, and contribute to IP policies and awareness sessions
• Prepare periodic reports on portfolio status, costs, and ongoing matters

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Law (S.H.)
• 2-3 years of IP experience in a law firm, IP consultancy, or in-house team (fresh graduates with IP internships or coursework may be considered)
• Understanding of Indonesian IP law and the DJKI filing process; knowledge of Madrid Protocol and PCT is a plus
• Ability to review contracts with close attention to IP clauses
• Fluent in English and Bahasa Indonesia
• Detail-oriented, organized, and able to manage multiple deadlines

Tanggung Jawab Pekerjaan (Responsibilities)

- Menyiapkan, mengajukan, dan memantau permohonan pendaftaran merek dagang, hak cipta, paten, dan desain industri kepada Direktorat Jenderal Kekayaan Intelektual (DJKI), serta mendukung proses pendaftaran internasional (Madrid Protocol dan PCT) melalui koordinasi dengan konsultan dan penasihat hukum di luar negeri.

- Melakukan pemeriksaan kelayakan pendaftaran merek dagang (trademark clearance) dan penelusuran paten terdahulu (prior-art search), merangkum potensi risiko, serta menanggapi surat keberatan atau penolakan dari DJKI (office actions) dan oposisi dalam batas waktu yang ditentukan oleh peraturan perundang-undangan.

- Meninjau perjanjian yang berkaitan dengan kekayaan intelektual, seperti NDA (Perjanjian Kerahasiaan), perjanjian lisensi, pengembangan, distribusi, kolaborasi, konsultasi, dan ketenagakerjaan; mengidentifikasi risiko terkait kekayaan intelektual serta mengusulkan revisi yang diperlukan.

- Memelihara dan memperbarui daftar aset kekayaan intelektual (IP Register), surat kuasa, serta dokumen terkait, termasuk memantau jadwal perpanjangan masa perlindungan, pembayaran biaya pemeliharaan paten (annuity), dan pencatatan perubahan data atau kepemilikan (recordals).

- Memantau marketplace, media sosial, dan nama domain untuk mendeteksi potensi pelanggaran hak kekayaan intelektual, serta membantu penanganan melalui surat teguran (cease-and-desist letters), permintaan penghapusan konten (takedown), dan tindakan penegakan hukum bersama penasihat hukum eksternal.

- Mendukung proses uji tuntas kekayaan intelektual (IP Due Diligence) serta pemeriksaan risiko pelanggaran hak kekayaan intelektual pihak ketiga dalam kerja sama bisnis dan pengembangan produk baru.

- Menjadi narahubung utama terkait kekayaan intelektual bagi seluruh tim internal, memberikan arahan mengenai penggunaan merek perusahaan dan konten milik pihak ketiga secara tepat, serta berkontribusi dalam penyusunan kebijakan dan program sosialisasi terkait kekayaan intelektual.

- Menyusun laporan berkala mengenai status portofolio kekayaan intelektual, biaya, serta perkembangan berbagai perkara atau proses yang sedang berjalan.

Persyaratan (Requirements)

- Pendidikan minimal Sarjana Hukum (S.H.).

- Memiliki pengalaman 2–3 tahun di bidang Kekayaan Intelektual (Intellectual Property/IP), baik di kantor hukum, konsultan kekayaan intelektual, maupun tim hukum internal perusahaan (in-house legal team). Lulusan baru dengan pengalaman magang atau mata kuliah terkait kekayaan intelektual dapat dipertimbangkan.

- Memahami peraturan perundang-undangan terkait kekayaan intelektual di Indonesia serta proses pengajuan pendaftaran melalui DJKI. Memiliki pengetahuan mengenai Madrid Protocol dan Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT) menjadi nilai tambah.

- Mampu melakukan peninjauan dan analisis kontrak dengan memperhatikan secara detail klausul-klausul yang berkaitan dengan kekayaan intelektual.

- Fasih berbahasa Inggris dan Bahasa Indonesia, baik lisan maupun tulisan.

- Teliti, terorganisir, memiliki kemampuan administrasi yang baik, serta mampu mengelola berbagai pekerjaan dengan tenggat waktu yang bersamaan.

Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.
